author: MuzzBuzz
body: My friends and I were messing around to see what the mods would do. I used the word 'nigga' and got temp banned for a week. I should have been warned beforehand. Pls unban.

title: Appeal

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
Testing the staff is exactly what we wouldn't want you to do, it wasn't appropriate to say, and your previous infraction history, regardless of age, is very oriented around broken chat offenses. Please wait out your punishment, your appeal has been declined.

As well as this, your recent behavior is inexcusable. http://pastie.org/private/grgm0w0gmvv2r3zweirxpq.

Regards,
Kavinsky.
